facts.fact: Max 在营地让自己有用起来：搬货箱、运木料、修爆破屏障。
facts.quote: Meanwhile, I made myself useful—carried crates, hauled timber, repaired blast barriers.

facts.fact: Max 睡得很差，黎明前醒来就往外跑；暗幕里“我们在这里”的唱和声又响了起来。
facts.quote:
I slept poorly and woke before dawn.



We’re here. We’re here.



The chanting started again as I ran.

facts.fact: Max 沿着暗幕外侧跑、离它半个街区，暗幕的拉扯一路拽住她的胸口，越跑越强。
facts.quote: I ran parallel to the Veil, half a block out. Its pull dragged at my chest, magnetic, deepening with every stride.

facts.fact: Max 想起妹妹 Missy 只有六岁半、她逃出时被独自留在 Crimson Ridge，最后被最凶的掠食者从奴隶矿抓走，成了“顶着她妹妹脸的人质”。
facts.quote: Missy was six and a half. Left alone in Crimson Ridge when I escaped.

facts.fact: Max 直直朝暗幕跑过去。
facts.quote: I jogged straight toward the Veil.

facts.fact: 一名 Spartan 士兵大喊质问 Cadet Max 在干什么，靴声从她身后急速逼近。
facts.quote: “Cadet Max! What the fuck are you doing?”

facts.fact: Max 把手掌按在暗幕上，阴影像黑绸顺纹裂开、为她让路，她顺势滑了进去。
facts.quote:
I pressed my palm to it.



Shadows drew apart for me like black silk splitting along the weave.

facts.fact: Max 冲破了阻力（空气涌入、她踉跄着站稳），只看见远处一片并非阳光的红色辉光——她已身在暗幕之内。
facts.quote:
Light hit—not sunlight but a reddish glow in the distance.



I was inside the DarkVeil.

relations: Max：女主、前奴隶、现役 Cadet；MISSY 的姐姐
Missy：Max 的妹妹，六岁半，被 Collector 从 Crimson Ridge 的奴隶矿抓走，作为针对 Max 的人质
Max 与 Aelindor / Caspian / Nikolai / Drakken（四位 heir）：他们把她从 Scorched Wastes 救出、承诺营救 Missy；她一度选择离开他们独睡自己的帐篷
Max 与 Oracle：靠 Coldiron 跨距离传递意图，暗幕中的 Coldiron 之河可充当两者之间的桥
Max 与 White Witch：敌对；Q-bomb 撕裂 Shimmer 并催生 DarkVeil，Max 讽刺她“干得好，白女巫”
Max 与 DarkVeil：暗幕用她的名字唱和并把她吸入；Spartan 守在它一个街区之外并被她越过
Max 与 archdemon：archdemon 被她的 Coldiron spike 刺伤后退去
Max 与 Spartans：营地共同作战的战友；一名 Spartan 追上来并喊停
numbers: Two more days until the transports came to take us back to the fortress.
No demon activity since the first wave.
Missy was six and a half.
The Spartans kept a full block back.
I stood three feet from the shifting shadows.
